name: matplotlib
title_zh: 连坐标轴刻度密度都要亲手指定的科研绘图底层库
tagline_zh: 当 seaborn 的默认样式配不上你的论文图，plotly 的交互又用不上时。
tagline_en: When seaborn's defaults feel generic and plotly's interactivity is overkill, matplotlib hands you every axis.
desc_en: Low-level plotting library for full customization. Use when you need fine-grained control over every plot element, creating novel plot types, or integrating with specific scientific workflows. Export to PNG/PDF/SVG for publication. For quick statistical plots use seaborn; for interactive plots use plotly; for publication-ready multi-panel figures with journal styling, use scientific-visualization.
why_zh: 不是封装，是地基。你直接操作 figure、axes、patch 对象。
why_en: Not a wrapper but the foundation. Manipulate figure, axes, and patch objects directly—any plot seaborn can't express, you build.
limit_zh: 只认 Python 环境且需自行管理中文字体；不提供统计计算，数据预处理得自己先做好；交互式探索请找 plotly。
limit_en: Python-only, Chinese fonts must be configured manually. No stats built-in—preprocess data yourself. For interactive exploration use plotly; for.
title_en: Low-level plotting lib for pixel-level chart control
